svg.text: 24 directions in six families · peacock #0f766e · small preview at 24px in each corner

foreignObject.div: A quote pressed in wax: on the record.
An opening and a closing mark: said, then heard.
The report itself: a quote, in the user's words.
Just the opening mark. Everything starts with what they said.
A bubble with a smaller answer tucked inside.
A bubble whose tail loops back: every report comes back answered.
The smallest version: something said, held and heard.
One line that listens; the dot is what was said.
Sound arriving, and someone actually listening.
Speech outside, listening inside.
You and your user, facing each other. The join is the conversation.
A lowercase h whose shoulder ends in a speech tail.
A solid bubble with an H cut out of it.
The bell of justice: anyone can ring it, and someone must answer.
A gavel whose head is a speech bubble: the ruling is a reply.
Two bubbles in balance: both sides get heard.
A courthouse whose door is a speech bubble.
The mark every report earns.
The eye on a peacock feather: being seen and heard.
A peacock-feather quill: the user writes, you read.
Feather fan made of speech bubbles: many users, one place.
A pause between "here" and "say": the moment of listening.
The name ends in a closing quote. Every report gets its end.
"here" over "say": the invitation, read top to bottom.
